ottoman.name: Ottoman Empire
ottoman.fato: One of the largest and longest-lasting dynasties in history, it ruled Southeastern Europe, the Middle East and North Africa for more than 600 years.

austria-hungria.name: Austria-Hungary
austria-hungria.fato: A dual monarchy joining the Austrian and Hungarian thrones under one emperor; it broke up into several countries at the end of World War I.

alemanha-nazista.name: Nazi Germany
alemanha-nazista.fato: Totalitarian regime led by Adolf Hitler; its defeat in World War II in 1945 ended the so-called Third Reich.

alemanha-oriental.name: East Germany (GDR)
alemanha-oriental.fato: Socialist state on the Soviet side of the Cold War; it reunified with West Germany in 1990, after the fall of the Berlin Wall.

urss.name: Soviet Union (USSR)
urss.fato: The largest country in the world by area; its dissolution in 1991 gave rise to 15 independent countries, Russia among them.

iugoslavia.name: Yugoslavia (SFR)
iugoslavia.fato: Socialist federation led by Tito, uniting six Balkan republics; it fragmented in violent wars in the 1990s.

tchecoslovaquia.name: Czechoslovakia
tchecoslovaquia.fato: Created after World War I; it dissolved peacefully in 1993 in what is known as the Velvet Divorce.

manchukuo.name: Manchukuo
manchukuo.fato: Puppet state created by Japan in Manchuria; it disappeared with Japan's defeat in World War II.

vietna-sul.name: South Vietnam
vietna-sul.fato: US-backed republic in the Vietnam War; it fell with the Fall of Saigon, leading to the country's reunification under the North.

katanga.name: State of Katanga
katanga.fato: Mineral-rich breakaway from the newly independent Democratic Republic of the Congo; reincorporated by force after a UN intervention.

biafra.name: Biafra
biafra.fato: Breakaway of southeastern Nigeria, mostly Igbo; the civil war that followed ended with its return to the country.

confederados.name: Confederate States of America
confederados.fato: Union of slaveholding southern US states that broke away from the Union, causing the American Civil War; defeated in 1865.

imperio-alemao.name: German Empire
imperio-alemao.fato: Germany unified under Prussian leadership; dissolved after defeat in World War I, giving way to the Weimar Republic.

reino-italia.name: Kingdom of Italy
reino-italia.fato: Italian unification under the House of Savoy; it became a republic after a popular referendum at the end of World War II.

persia-qajar.name: Persia (Qajar dynasty)
persia-qajar.fato: Persian dynasty deposed by a military coup that brought Reza Khan to power, founding the Pahlavi dynasty.

ira-pahlavi.name: Iran (Imperial State, Pahlavi)
ira-pahlavi.fato: Modernizing monarchy of the shahs Reza and Mohammad Reza Pahlavi; overthrown by the Iranian Revolution of 1979.

mogol.name: Mughal Empire
mogol.fato: One of the largest empires in Indian history; effectively dissolved after the Indian Rebellion of 1857, when India came under direct British rule.

camboja-democratico.name: Democratic Kampuchea (Khmer Rouge)
camboja-democratico.fato: Khmer Rouge regime led by Pol Pot, marked by genocide; overthrown by the Vietnamese invasion.

tibete.name: Tibet
tibete.fato: De facto independent after the fall of the Qing dynasty; annexed by China in 1951, still a disputed territory today.

afeganistao-rdc.name: Afghanistan (Democratic Republic)
afeganistao-rdc.fato: Cold War communist regime backed by the Soviet Union; it fell after the Soviet withdrawal and the advance of the mujahideen.

reino-egito.name: Kingdom of Egypt
reino-egito.fato: Semi-independent monarchy under British influence; overthrown by the Egyptian Revolution of 1952, led by Nasser.

rau.name: United Arab Republic
rau.fato: Political union between Egypt and Syria; Syria withdrew in 1961, but Egypt kept the official name until 1971.

zanzibar.name: Sultanate of Zanzibar
zanzibar.fato: Trading sultanate in the Indian Ocean; it merged with Tanganyika soon after a revolution, forming Tanzania.

transvaal.name: South African Republic (Transvaal)
transvaal.fato: Gold-rich Boer republic; annexed by the British Empire after the Second Boer War.

orange.name: Orange Free State
orange.fato: Another independent Boer republic; annexed by the British in the same war that ended the Transvaal.

congo-leopoldo.name: Congo Free State
congo-leopoldo.fato: Personal property of King Leopold II of Belgium, not a Belgian colony; notorious for the abuses committed against the local population.

etiope.name: Ethiopian Empire
etiope.fato: One of the oldest states in the world, never truly colonized; the monarchy fell to a military coup that installed the communist Derg regime.

sokoto.name: Sokoto Caliphate
sokoto.fato: One of the largest precolonial Islamic states in Africa; annexed by the British, today part of northern Nigeria.

texas.name: Republic of Texas
texas.fato: Independent from Mexico after the Texas Revolution; annexed by the US, becoming the American state of Texas.

havai.name: Kingdom of Hawaii
havai.fato: Polynesian monarchy unified by Kamehameha I; overthrown by a coup backed by American business interests and annexed by the US in 1898.

commonwealth-inglaterra.name: Commonwealth of England
commonwealth-inglaterra.fato: Republic that followed the execution of King Charles I in the English Civil War; the monarchy was restored in 1660 with Charles II.

reino-romenia.name: Kingdom of Romania
reino-romenia.fato: Romanian monarchy that lived through both world wars; abolished when King Michael I was forced to abdicate by the communists.

china-cinco-cores.name: China (Beiyang government)
china-cinco-cores.fato: The first Chinese republican government after the fall of the Qing dynasty; the "Five-Colored Flag" stood for the union of five ethnic groups.

iemen-norte.name: North Yemen
iemen-norte.fato: The Yemen Arab Republic, formed after the fall of the Zaydi imamate; it unified with South Yemen in 1990, forming today's Yemen.

iemen-sul.name: South Yemen
iemen-sul.fato: The People's Democratic Republic of Yemen, the only Marxist state in the Arab world; it unified with North Yemen in 1990.

birmania-socialista.name: Socialist Burma
birmania-socialista.fato: The Socialist Republic of the Union of Burma, under one-party military rule; it fell after massive popular protests in 1988.

india-britanica.name: British India
india-britanica.fato: Direct rule of the British Crown over the Indian subcontinent; divided at independence in 1947 into India and Pakistan.

congo-leopoldville.name: Congo-Léopoldville
congo-leopoldville.fato: The country's name right after independence from Belgium, before it became Zaire and later the Democratic Republic of the Congo; this is the first flag of the republican period, already replaced in 1963.

rodesia-norte.name: Northern Rhodesia
rodesia-norte.fato: British protectorate that became independent as Zambia in 1964; distinct from neighboring Southern Rhodesia (which declared unilateral independence in 1965).

somalilandia-britanica.name: British Somaliland
somalilandia-britanica.fato: British protectorate in the Horn of Africa; it was independent for only a few days in 1960 before joining former Italian Somaliland to form Somalia.

america-central-federal.name: Federal Republic of Central America
america-central-federal.sucessor: Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua and Costa Rica
america-central-federal.fato: Federal union that succeeded imperial Mexico in the region; it broke up into Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua and Costa Rica.

west-florida.name: Republic of West Florida
west-florida.fato: Independence of American settlers against Spain; it lasted only 74 days before being annexed by the United States, and gave rise to the "Bonnie Blue" lone-star flag.

confederacao-argentina.name: Argentine Confederation
confederacao-argentina.fato: Confederal union of the Argentine provinces under the leadership of Juan Manuel de Rosas; it gave way to today's centralized Argentina.

italia-salo.name: Italian Social Republic (Salò)
italia-salo.fato: Nazi puppet state led by Mussolini in northern Italy after he was deposed; extinguished with Germany's defeat in World War II.

trieste.name: Free Territory of Trieste
trieste.fato: Independent city-state created by the UN after World War II, disputed between Italy and Yugoslavia; divided between the two countries in 1954.

danzig.name: Free City of Danzig
danzig.fato: City-state under League of Nations protection after World War I, with a German majority; annexed by Nazi Germany in 1939, the trigger for the invasion of Poland.

sikkim.name: Kingdom of Sikkim
sikkim.fato: Himalayan kingdom between India and Tibet; annexed by India in 1975 after a referendum, becoming the Indian state of Sikkim.

paquistao-oriental.name: East Pakistan
paquistao-oriental.fato: Eastern part of Pakistan, geographically separated by India; it became independent as Bangladesh after the 1971 Liberation War.

ceilao-britanico.name: British Ceylon
ceilao-britanico.fato: British colony on the island now known as Sri Lanka; it became independent in 1948 as a Commonwealth dominion.

alto-volta.name: Upper Volta
alto-volta.fato: Name of the country now known as Burkina Faso before Thomas Sankara's revolution, which changed its name and flag in 1984.

rodesia-niassalandia.name: Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland
rodesia-niassalandia.fato: Union of the British colonies that are now Zambia, Zimbabwe and Malawi; dissolved under pressure from African independence movements.

rodesia-sul-colonial.name: Southern Rhodesia
rodesia-sul-colonial.fato: Self-governing British colony that preceded the independent Rhodesia (UDI) of 1965; it became Zimbabwe in 1980.

cisplatina.name: Cisplatine Province
cisplatina.fato: Territory annexed by the Empire of Brazil, corresponding to present-day Uruguay; it became independent after the Cisplatine War.

nova-granada.name: United States of New Granada
nova-granada.fato: Federal union of provinces that preceded modern Colombia; renamed the United States of Colombia in 1863.

nigeria-britanica.name: British Nigeria
nigeria-britanica.fato: British colony formed by merging the northern and southern protectorates; independent in 1960 as Nigeria.

dutch-republic.name: Republic of the Seven United Provinces

reino-grecia.name: Kingdom of Greece
reino-grecia.fato: A monarchy founded in 1832 after the war of independence against the Ottomans; with a republican interlude from 1924 to 1935, it lasted until the monarchy was abolished in 1973.

reino-montenegro.name: Kingdom of Montenegro
reino-montenegro.sucessor: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes
reino-montenegro.fato: The principality became a kingdom in 1910; occupied in World War I, it was united with Serbia in November 1918 while its government was still in exile.

malta-britanica.name: British Malta
malta-britanica.fato: The British protectorate became a Crown colony in 1813, which the Treaty of Paris confirmed in 1814; it became independent in 1964.

chipre-britanico.name: British Cyprus
chipre-britanico.fato: Run by the United Kingdom from 1878 as a protectorate, it was annexed in 1914, became a Crown colony in 1925 and gained independence in 1960.

afeganistao-emirado.name: Emirate of Afghanistan
afeganistao-emirado.fato: A Central Asian emirate covering present-day Afghanistan and parts of Iran, Pakistan, Turkmenistan and Tajikistan; in 1926 it became the Kingdom of Afghanistan.

estados-malaios-federados.name: Federated Malay States
estados-malaios-federados.fato: A federation of four British protectorates on the Malay Peninsula (Selangor, Perak, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang); in 1946 it joined the Malayan Union.

estabelecimentos-estreitos.name: Straits Settlements
estabelecimentos-estreitos.fato: British territories in Southeast Asia, Singapore, Penang and Malacca among them, set up in 1826 by the East India Company and a Crown colony from 1867; dissolved in 1946, after the Japanese occupation.

hong-kong-britanico.name: British Hong Kong
hong-kong-britanico.fato: A British Crown colony from the occupation of Hong Kong Island in 1841, with the Japanese occupation of 1941 to 1945 in between; it was handed over to China in July 1997.

quedivato-egito.name: Khedivate of Egypt
quedivato-egito.fato: An autonomous tributary state of the Ottoman Empire ruled by the Muhammad Ali dynasty; the sultan granted the title of khedive to Isma'il Pasha in 1867, and in 1914 the country became a sultanate under a British protectorate.

africa-oriental-britanica.name: East Africa Protectorate
africa-oriental-britanica.fato: A British protectorate in the African Great Lakes, roughly present-day Kenya, from the Indian Ocean to the border with Uganda; in 1920 it became the Kenya Colony.

protetorado-uganda.name: Uganda Protectorate
protetorado-uganda.fato: A British protectorate set up in 1894 around the Kingdom of Buganda and extended to an area close to today's Uganda; it became independent in 1962. Its flag shows a crowned crane.

niassalandia.name: Nyasaland
niassalandia.fato: The name given in 1907 to the British Central Africa Protectorate; it was part of the Federation of Rhodesia and Nyasaland from 1953 to 1963 and became independent in 1964 as Malawi.

uniao-sul-africana.name: Union of South Africa
uniao-sul-africana.fato: A British Dominion created in 1910 by uniting the Cape, Natal, Transvaal and Orange River colonies; the predecessor of today's Republic of South Africa, proclaimed in 1961.

costa-do-ouro.name: Gold Coast
costa-do-ouro.fato: A British colony on the Gulf of Guinea, named after the region's gold; it became independent in 1957 as Ghana.

mauricio-britanico.name: British Mauritius
mauricio-britanico.fato: The former Isle de France, taken from France in 1810 and confirmed as British by the Treaty of Paris; it became independent in 1968.

seychelles-britanicas.name: British Seychelles
seychelles-britanicas.fato: A British Crown colony from 1903 until independence in 1976; James Mancham was elected its first president.

terra-nova-dominio.name: Dominion of Newfoundland
terra-nova-dominio.fato: A British Dominion made up of the island of Newfoundland and Labrador on the mainland; in 1949 it joined Canada, where it is the province of Newfoundland and Labrador.

honduras-britanicas.name: British Honduras
honduras-britanicas.fato: The United Kingdom's last mainland colony in the Americas, on the southern edge of the Yucatán Peninsula; it was renamed Belize in 1973 and became independent in 1981.

jamaica-colonial.name: Colony of Jamaica
jamaica-colonial.fato: Taken from Spain by the English in 1655, it lived off sugar exports from plantations worked by enslaved Africans; it became independent in 1962.

bahamas-britanicas.name: British Bahamas
bahamas-britanicas.fato: A British colony from the arrival of governor Woodes Rogers in Nassau in 1718; the flag badge, a British ship chasing pirates, recalls their expulsion. Independent in 1973.

trinidad-tobago-colonial.name: Colony of Trinidad and Tobago
trinidad-tobago-colonial.fato: The two islands were joined into a single British colony in 1889; they became independent in 1962 and a republic in 1976.

barbados-colonial.name: Colony of Barbados
barbados-colonial.fato: An English and later British colony, first settled in 1627 near present-day Holetown; it became independent in 1966.

barlavento-britanicas.name: British Windward Islands
barlavento-britanicas.sucessor: Grenada, Saint Lucia and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
barlavento-britanicas.fato: An administrative grouping of British colonies in the Caribbean; in 1914 it joined Grenada, Saint Lucia and Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (Barbados left in 1885 and Tobago in 1889). It lasted until 1958.

guiana-britanica.name: British Guiana
guiana-britanica.fato: Dutch colonies ceded to the United Kingdom in 1814 and joined in 1831 as British Guiana; it became independent in 1966 as Guyana.

salomao-britanicas.name: British Solomon Islands
salomao-britanicas.fato: A British protectorate declared in 1893 over the southern Solomons and later extended to most of today's country; it became independent in 1978.
